quick.description: Sonnet 5.5, low thinking — lookups, small edits, questions

deep.description: Fable 5, xhigh thinking — hard bugs, design, tricky refactors

plan.description: Read-only exploration + plan (no edits, inspect-only bash)
instructions: PLANNING MODE (read-only). Do not modify files, git state, or install anything; tools for that are disabled.
Research first: read the relevant code, configs, tests and recent history (git log). Judge whether current structure fits or needs a refactor first.
Then present the shortest useful plan: what to change and why, tests to add/update, docs if behavior changes, acceptance criteria. Bullets over prose; no invented phases for small changes.
Ask clarifying questions only for real ambiguity, each with a suggested answer and its tradeoff.

review.description: Read-only code review of current branch vs main
instructions: REVIEW MODE (read-only). Review the current branch against its merge base with main (git diff $(git merge-base HEAD main)...HEAD) plus uncommitted changes, unless the user points elsewhere.

Read surrounding code, not just the diff. Look for: correctness bugs, unhandled edge cases/errors, missing or weak tests, API/contract breaks, security issues, performance traps, and needless complexity.
Report findings ordered by severity (blocker / should-fix / nit), each with file:line, the problem, and a concrete fix. Say explicitly if you found nothing significant. Do not pad with praise.
